agencyName: Office of the Revisor of Statutes, State of Minnesota
authorityRationale: Minnesota Statutes 326B.33, Subdivision 20 (Reciprocity), quoted directly: 'The commissioner may issue a personal license without requiring the applicant to pass an examination provided the applicant... holds a valid comparable license in the state participating in the agreement.' The literal statutory basis for exempting reciprocal electrician applicants from Minnesota's own exam — a stronger, positively-stated source than Arkansas's rules text, which never explicitly addressed this question.
reliabilityRationale: The codified state statute itself, hosted by the Minnesota Revisor's Office — the single highest-authority source class available, though the statute (326B.33) governs personal licensing across multiple CCLD-regulated trades, not electricians exclusively.
